## par-p02-v02 — argument map

Thesis: the Lord is light-selfed; light is awareness-natured (prakāśātmā, vimarśasvabhāvaḥ). Objection: granted light-nature, why not mere-knowing-nature like the calm-brahman teachers (nanu... śāntabrahmavādināmiva)? Reply: awareness twofold (bounded/unbounded) and three-functioned (emission/maintenance/withdrawal as full-I-joy); maxim: flashing as the unmade I. Consequence: awareness-less shining falls lordless and inert — sun proved (yadi nirvimarśaḥ... sūryādi).

### Open
- parimita/aparimita introduced to block the void-knower ceiling, left undeveloped.
- Sun analogy extends by parity of reason, not identity.
